public_rationale: Goodside and Papay's comparison of the early Claude, published January 17, 2023, records several hallucinations. Claude named the wrong Super Bowl winner. It invented terms it attributed to a Stanislaw Lem story. Its summaries of Lost became 'almost entirely confabulated' by Season 4. These were ordinary factual prompts, so Claude did land in hallucination readily, much as ChatGPT did. The same post notes that Claude sometimes declined questions it could not answer and avoided one hallucination ChatGPT made. So the claim holds, though Claude was not uniformly worse.
limitations: The comparison is informal and based on few prompts.
'Quickly' is a loose word; the post shows hallucinations on everyday prompts but does not measure speed or frequency.
